integrity: The package supplies the complete proof and standalone exact-rational checker; no independent mathematical verification or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact-degree evaluation on the 20 normalized A4 roots in S^3 with unit-diagonal Gegenbauer Gram; no generalization to other root systems or perturbations. The proof contains infinite-degree analytic bounds; finite rational tests supplement it. Originality assessment is bounded, older equivalent association-scheme literature remains a risk.
title: A double sharp conditioning resonance for harmonic sampling on the \(A_4\) roots
